<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **7** documentable anchor(s).

**8** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx`  _(via readonlyWhen (literal))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx`  _(via readonlyWhen (literal))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx`  _(via readonlyWhen (literal))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx`  _(via readonlyWhen (literal))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/validation-rules.mdx`  _(via readonlyWhen (literal))_
- `content/docs/kernel/contracts/data-engine.mdx`  _(via WriteObservabilityOptions (symbol), readonlyWhen (literal))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectql/security.mdx`  _(via readonlyWhen (literal))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`  _(via readonlyWhen (literal))_

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/implementation-status.mdx`  _(via readonlyWhen (literal))_
- `content/docs/releases/v15.mdx`  _(via readonlyWhen (literal))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)

Coarse fallback — **114** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json origin/main` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs origin/main` → pass the list as `args.docs`.
